# Booth rent, commission or employee: what do you really take home per hour worked?

> Compare booth rent, commission and an hourly job for a nail tech: take-home per hour worked, break-even clients per week. Free, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
